verdict.rationale: Sentry's AI agent monitoring is documented for tracing, conversations, LLM calls, costs and tool calls. Datasets and evals are a fair axis for an LLM-observability product, but the evidence shows no dataset creation, no eval runs, and no programmatic way to trigger runs or read back results. The existence of a CLI and llms.txt does not show any evals capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create a dataset, trigger an eval run programmatically, and read back the results
